Mr. Anupam Vasdani — Group Chief Financial Officer, True Balance India.
Speaker at Global Fintech Fest 2026.
Based in: India.
Speaking in "Cheaper to Run, Not Cheaper to Fund: Confronting NBFC Lending's Unsolved Capital Cost Problem" (A0795) — Panel Discussion, Day 3 (Friday 11 September 2026), 10:50–11:30.
As Chief Financial Officer of True Balance, Anupam Vasdani drives the financial strategy and fiscal health of the company’s expanding digital ecosystem. With over 20 years of expertise in corporate finance, treasury management, and fundraising, he builds the structural foundation necessary for large-scale growth. Anupam balances disciplined financial planning with modern risk management, using AI to optimize asset-liability management and market forecasting. Previously, as CFO at Toyota Financial Services India, Anupam led a robust funding unit raising ₹200 billion annually via NCDs, commercial paper, and offshore markets. His career features key roles at Habitat Housing Finance, Deutsche Postbank Home Finance, and FiNoble Advisors, overseeing treasury operations and private equity advisory. A Chartered Accountant (ICAI), Anupam blends institutional expertise with fintech agility. He ensures seamless capital flows and regulatory compliance, providing financial stability to scale operations across India.

sessions.title: Cheaper to Run, Not Cheaper to Fund: Confronting NBFC Lending's Unsolved Capital Cost Problem

Building on this experience, he played a role in the functional design, testing, and implementation of TARGET2-Securities (T2S), the Eurosystem’s pioneering multi-currency securities settlement platform. title: Prof. G Sivakumar
text:
Prof. G Sivakumar — Porfessor, IIT Bombay.
Speaker at Global Fintech Fest 2026.
Based in: India.
Speaking in "Quantum Risk in BFSI: Securing Cryptography for a Post‑Quantum World" (A1012) — Panel Discussion, Day 1 (Wednesday 9 September 2026), 12:30–13:10.
Prof. G. Sivakumar has been on the faculty of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Bombay, since 1991. His core research interests are in the applications of Logic in diverse areas of Computer Science such as Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering and Network Security. title: Trust.Connect.Convert: The ROI-Driven Customer Journey
text:

Roundtable · Day 2 (Thursday 10 September 2026), 13:30–15:30 · Hall 102.
ACCESS: closed-door / invite-only. This session is NOT open to general attendees and must not be recommended as attendable.
For BFSI and fintech brands in India, communication is the business. Every acquisition, onboarding, collection, renewal, and cross-sell process runs through a call, message, or notification. Yet a channel is only as valuable as it is trusted: unidentified calls go unanswered, impersonation fraud quietly erodes confidence, and disconnected touchpoints turn a single relationship into a series of cold starts. This roundtable reframes the question. What happens when communication stops being a set of isolated channels and campaigns, and becomes a connected journey — one verified identity and one context, carried from the moment before first contact, through the funnel, all the way to conversion and lasting loyalty? With Truecaller for Business's solution platform, that journey becomes measurable: in acquisition, retention, and growth.
